original_query: MATCH (rk:Spec {specNumber:'38.214'})<-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]-(src:Section {sectionNumber:'5.1'}) WHERE rk.specRelease IS NOT NULL WITH src, rk ORDER BY toInteger(replace(rk.specRelease,'Rel-','')) DESC LIMIT 1 MATCH (src)-[:REFERENCES_SECTION]->(tgt:Section) RETURN tgt.sectionNumber, tgt.sectionTitle ORDER BY tgt.sectionNumber
question_en: Which sections does TS 38.214 Section 5.1 reference? (companion reading for implementation)
reference_query:
MATCH (hub:Spec {specNumber:'38.214'})
WHERE hub.specRelease IS NULL
MATCH (sp:Spec)-[:IN_RELEASE_OF]->(hub)
MATCH (src:Section {sectionNumber:'5.1'})-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]->(sp)
MATCH (src)-[:REFERENCES_SECTION]->(tgt:Section)
RETURN DISTINCT tgt.sectionId AS sectionId
